REDIS_URL.description: Redis connection URL (required). For local development use redis://localhost:6379. Heroku automatically sets this for production.

WOW_VERSION.description: World of Warcraft version (retail or classic)

SUPABASE_URL.description: Your Supabase project URL (optional, for activity logging)

OAUTH_BASE_URL.description: Your server's public URL for OAuth callbacks

OAUTH_PROVIDER.description: OAuth provider to use for authentication. Options: discord (empty = disabled)

BLIZZARD_REGION.description: Blizzard API region (e.g., us, eu, kr, tw)

API_TIMEOUT_TOTAL.description: Total API timeout in seconds (necessary for reducing API traffic to Blizzard)

DISCORD_CLIENT_ID.description: Discord OAuth client ID (required if OAUTH_PROVIDER is set to discord)

BLIZZARD_CLIENT_ID.description: Your Blizzard Battle.net API client ID (required)

SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY.description: Supabase service role key that bypasses RLS (optional, for activity logging)

DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Discord OAuth client secret (required if OAUTH_PROVIDER is set to discord)

BLIZZARD_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Your Blizzard Battle.net API client secret (required)
